reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Insight into my undergrad experience.

review_content.Placements: There are about 150 students who were taken into the course every year. The course is 5.5 years long, where we are required to do a mandatory rotatory internship of 1-year duration in the institutional hospital. Although, when posted in PSM, we are required to work in PHCs as per the set duration.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a residential hostel on the campus available for all the undergraduates, whether choosing to stay there is a matter of personal convenience. The classrooms are what you usually see, nothing out of the ordinary. Labs with respect to all the presentation and paraclinical departments, along with demonstration rooms, would be present in the respective departments. There's a college canteen which operates as long as the college hours do, a library, and other necessary requirements.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: If you are too studious and want to be a ranked student the teachers here will help you out.

review_content.Placements: As it is a medical college, the placements depend upon how you study and do well in the entrance exams, which are to be held in the future by the medical council. If you are hardworking and put in the maximum efforts, you can get into a good college for your post-graduation after undergrad.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are a lot of lecture halls with air conditioning in them. Every department has a separate lab for its purpose with all the equipment required. The hospital too has labs for different departments. The library is present with adequate books and space to relax and focus on studies. The college has a canteen with average food, and as there is a lot to study, sports and games are occasionally held with no restrictions. There is one just opposite the college, which is a place of attraction.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good teaching quality, and faculty members also good. Campus was good.

review_content.Placements: There were 90 to 100 students in our class. The average package for our course varies from year to year. As a 2023 batch graduate, my total package is about 4 lacs per year. The classes and faculty members are good. All students received internships through our college. Our college has an independent multi-specialty hospital that provides all the facilities needed for our internship.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good facilities. Each department has labs and lecture theaters. There is a large central library for studying and borrowing books, and a cafeteria. The hostel is okay. They provide breakfast, lunch, dinner, and evening snacks. The food is prepared according to a schedule and menu, and it is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: This college is only good for completing MBBS, don't expect more.

review_content.Placements: The college has a good number of students entering, 150 per year. But many people fail too. Almost 40% of people fail every year. Incoming patients are also comparatively less. But teaching is nice and lecturers are good too. The college is still improving. Overall the college is good only for completing the course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very poor. Basic facilities are not there. Many deep cracks are there throughout the building. The classrooms are good but no air-conditioner. Libraries also have very basic facilities. The hostel also has poor infrastructure. Food is also not that good.

review_content.Placements: My college is a medical college. It's not about the placements but the bond that it offers. The internship placements are 100% from our college. After completion of 4.5 years, the college offers an internship for 30,070 rupees per month for 12 months. Students here get 100% internships in the same college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is fabulous, as it is a central government institution. The cleanliness is unmatched when compared with state government colleges. The hostel offers 3 meals a day for the students in the hostel mess. Students don't need to go anywhere else for food. The taste of the food is bearable. The hostel has its own playroom, where they have carrom and chess for the students. The medical facilities are the best, as it is a medical hostel; casualty is open all the time if anybody faces any health issue.

review_summary.college_name: ESIC Medical College, Gulbarga Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Review of ESIC Medical College, Gulbarga.

content.Placements: I applied to many other medical colleges in Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka, and I even tried for an upgradation after I got this college in my first allotment, but I didn’t get any higher options since MBBS allotment processes are strictly based on All India Ranks in the NEET-UG exam. After the allotment results are published, the date for joining is announced later. On the respective date, the student and a guardian should be present at the college academic block with the certificates listed in the checklist.
content.Infrastructure: The college has an indoor badminton court and a canteen. The table tennis courts are under renovation. Class timings are from 8 AM to 4 PM. The lunch break is at 1 PM. The hostel and college gates close sharply at 9:30 PM. The college campus is completely safe, but it is not recommended to roam alone outside the campus after 9 PM. Hyderabad is just 4 hours away by train.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Impressive infrastructure and placements could be improved.

content.Placements: 98% of students got placed. The avearge salary is Rs 15,000 per month. The highest salary is Rs 21,000 per month. The lowest salary is Rs 8,000 per month. 99% of students get their internships with a stipend of Rs 5,000 per month. Top roles offered are general physician and junior president doctors.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is nice, quite picturesque, and large campus to walk around. Our campus is safe and security team is always on duty. Provisions of Wi-Fi and multiple labs for every subject for research purposes are allowed on special permission. Hostel is comfy. The food is alright with a variety of messes to choose from, Rajasthan, North Indian, Kerela, etc. Food expenses are around Rs 4000 per month. The college is attached to 500 beds multi-specialty hospital which was built in 2013 and became operational in 2014. The campus is spread over 75 acres and provides primary and tertiary healthcare facilities to the workers insured under the ESI corporation as well as non-insured persons. It is one of the tertiary care referral centers for smaller ESI clinics and dispensaries.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of the infrastructure, library is great, campus life is good.

content.Placements: There are 150 students in my course. There are no packages offered in my course, nor are there any recruiting companies because it is a medical college, guys! It's an undergraduate medical college where you can only learn and get "Dr." in front of your name. There is still an MD or MS to be done.
content.Infrastructure: There is no college Wi-Fi available. We have to put up our own Wi-Fi. The hostels are livable; we can manage, but the washrooms aren't too good. The library is great! We can study for however long we want. They don't issue books, though; we just have to sit and study. We have a canteen, which is fine. Sports are played.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: ESIC GULBARGA: the best infrastructure and study patterns.

content.Placements: My college is a medical college. It's not about the placements but the bond that it offers. The internship placements are 100% from our college. After completion of 4.5 years, the college offers an internship for 30,070 rupees per month for 12 months. After that, the college gives a 1-year salary bond to the students, in which the students have to serve in the college or its branches for a year with a 1 lac plus package per month, for a total of around a 12 LPA package. Students here get 100% internships in the same college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is fabulous, as it is a central government institution. The cleanliness is unmatched when compared with state government colleges. The hostel offers 3 meals a day for the students in the hostel mess. Students don't need to go anywhere else for food. The taste of the food is bearable. The hostel has its own playroom, where they have carrom and chess for the students. The medical facilities are the best, as it is a medical hostel; casualty is open all the time if anybody faces any health issue.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent college, and I recommend students to join it.

content.Placements: In our batch, there are 125 students. It is a good college. The college fee is Rs.100000 per annum. Most of our interns will complete their internships with good experience and knowledge and become successful in their future careers.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities. A library is available. The college has good environment. Our classrooms are digital.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are excellent. The teaching quality is good. First, they will teach on the board, and then they will easily explain the dissection part using PPTs and 3D models.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth to consider Axis Colleges as a good Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Axis Colleges is a reputed institute for B.Com, B.Sc., UG Diploma, B.Pharma, BBA, BCA, D.Pharma, B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, B.Arch, BFA, M.E./M.Tech, After 1th Diploma, MCA, M.FTech. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Accounting & Commerce, Science, Design, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Engineering, Architecture & Planning, Arts ( Fine / Visual / Performing ), Mass Communication & Media, Animation. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. As per Shiksha verified reviews, Axis Colleges has a rating of 3.7 on the basis of reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 3.9 on campuslife, 3.3 on placements, 3.8 on faculty and 3.9 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Axis Colleges Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Review of Axis Colleges.

content.Placements: A nice percentage of the students are placed in this course. The highest package offered to a college student is more than 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies visit this course. The percentage of student internships in my course is very nice. A top role is offered by my Myntra company.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for students in my course are good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and a library are present for the students in this college. The quality of food available in canteen is so tasty, and sports and games are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Axis Colleges – A balanced mix of academics and opportunities.

content.Placements: Axis College students receive placement support. Top recruiters include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, Flipkart, and Amazon. The average package is 4-5 LPA, with top students getting a high package. Students regularly get internship opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Axis College has a modern and well-maintained infrastructure. The classrooms are digital and spacious, fully equipped labs provide hands-on learning, and the library has a wide collection of books and journals. Hostel and mess facilities are decent with proper hygiene, Wi-Fi is available across campus, and sports grounds as well as an auditorium are also present. Overall, the infrastructure creates a very good environment for both academics and extracurricular activities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure is good. Bus facilities and the hostel are good.

content.Placements: In our course, 0% students were placed, because in this college, no core companies visit, only BPO service and consulting companies, which are hiring at low cost, but my course needed the core companies that are not provided by my college. In my class, only one student was placed on HCL on a technical support post.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and hostel are good and neat and clean, which also provides a good environment to grow. It also provides fully AC classes and 4+ computer labs with Wi-Fi and valuable software that are needed to do work. It provides a full range of subject books available in the library.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Axis College is awesome. They do all of these things which you need.

content.Placements: The placement percentage of our college is something like 30% of the students. The highest placement package is 50 LPA and the lowest is 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, INFOSYS, HCL, etc. At least 75% and above and knowledge is a must. Internship program is held in my college join this and make your resume special.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is a small bit more than average. They provide good facilities for students. I don't know about the hostel but the mess is too good. Hostel rooms are too good ragging is not allowed, its safe for students. Hostel students have more facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: More than 50 multinational companies visit Axis Colleges.

content.Placements: 70% of the students get placed. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the average package ranges from 5 to 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Tech Mahindra, HCL, TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. 90% of students receive internships from Edunet and Codenest. The top roles offered are for full-stack developers and web developers.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Labs have Wi-Fi and a library is available. Classrooms have air conditioning. The food from the hostel mess is delicious, and every hostel room has enough space. Medical facilities are available as well. There is a wide field for sports and outdoor games.

review_summary.college_name: Gayatri Vidya Parishad Institute of Healthcare and Medical Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Our college has the best faculty and good facilities.

content.Placements: Every batch has 150 members of students. Professors can explain the topics elaborately, which can be easily understood by students. Almost 100% of students got internships at our college. Moreover, after completing the course, there are a wide variety of jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has everything that is useful for students, from a library to lab equipment. But coming to hostels, they need to improve so much, like food and drinking water supply for every floor. Except that, everything is perfect.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I'm absolutely satisfied with teachers, teaching environment and high campus placements.

content.Placements: Our college consists of 150 students per batch. All students get selected for internships as well as for the best top institutions to get jobs at various levels all over the country. Our college also provides the opportunity to be eligible for various examinations.
content.Infrastructure: Our college consists of air-conditioned classrooms for every batch. There is a library, playground, auditorium, canteen, hostel, hospital mess and various other facilities for all students and staff members. Our college conducts various programs, curricular activities and a positive environment.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with all the facilities and teachers, but it doesn't encourage cultural and sports.

content.Placements: Every batch has 150 students. In this college, we are the first batch, so we don't know how much salary they offer. We are 3rd-year students, so we don't have any placements and salary packages. After graduation, the salary offered to us may be Rs. 25,000 per month. My main aim is to get admission in PG in a government college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is good. Hostel rooms are spacious, and 3 students are accommodated in a single room. Rooms have attached washroom. The quality of the food served is good, but the taste depends on the chef. Wi-Fi is provided only in the library. Our college doesn't have a canteen but has a tuck shop. Our college provides less encouragement for sports and cultural.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with our college due to teachers, studies, infrastructure and everything.

content.Placements: Students who have good NEET rank got placed from our course. We can work in any hospital, but mostly we are offered to get a PG after MBBS in our college. The lowest salary of Rs. 25,000 per month and the highest salary of up to Rs. 70,000 per month are offered for MBBS graduates. Almost all students get jobs after completing MBBS.
content.Infrastructure: The food served is good, but we don't have non-vegetarian food. The canteen is not that great, but you can have basics things. Sports and games are encouraged to a limit. Our college had a library and study rooms, which are good enough. Seminar halls, demo rooms, labs and everything are fine. First-year students will get 4 cadavers for dissection.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The worst college in Mumbai for engineering.

content.Placements: The college was not at all good when it comes to placements. Maximum students are not least in the placement and no good companies come for the recruitment of the final year students. The maximum package was 400000 rupees per annum and the average package was around 222000 rupees for annum and the lowest package was around 150000 per annum. 35 percent students were place d during my year but not in good MNCs like TCS, Will, L&T etc. Startups come to recruit students. Top roles offered are in sales department.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is bad. Our college has good sports facilities like football ground basketball ground tennis court. College supports in intercollegiate sports events. The Wi-Fi facility is bad. It didn't work properly in campus. The classrooms were spacious but cleanliness was a big concern. Library had books with full of dust on it. There was hostel facility which was separate for both boys and girls. There was no canteens on campus. There was no as such infrastructure facilities in the college. The campus is really bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: It is the worst college, and it mainly focuses on money.

content.Placements: There were no placements at all. It is the worst ever college, and they didn't even pay back my EBC scholarship. I suggest that never join this institute. There are no teachers here and waste of career and studies here.
content.Infrastructure: There are no Wi-Fi facility, labs and medical facilities. Hostels are the worst, and the food is also the worst. It is the worst college. Only Rs. 500 was due, so they didn't allow to write the final year exams, because of that I got less marks in those subjects. The college focuses only on fees, but not on students career.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: A very poor college in academics with zero placements.

content.Placements: Placements in the college were nil. Not even a single company visited the campus for placements of our batch and senior's batch. The college doesn't even make any efforts for inviting companies to the campus for placements. The college doesn't provide any internships. You have to look for placements and internships on your own.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is decent enough. The college has computer labs, but they are not that well-equipped. Classrooms are big but not neat and clean. The college has a nice library with ample books to refer. Food served in the canteen is not that good. Hostel facilities are very bad, and the rooms are very small and not in proper condition.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Such type of college should be shut down.

content.Placements: There are no placements or campus interviews in the college. No senior or current students are placed from any branch. There is no question of the highest or lowest package with no placements, and the same goes with the internships. There is no placement cell in the college.
content.Infrastructure: The college has no proper infrastructure. The city is famous for the waterfall, and so is the college. There is a leakage in every corner. There are no other facilities like Wi-Fi, classroom, library, medical, and sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, but not satisfied with the faculty and management.

content.Placements: Placements in the college are not that good. Only one or two companies visit the college for placements. There were no placements for two of our senior batches. What I heard from my seniors is that the companies offer call centre jobs. But from last year onwards, the college is working at bringing in good placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. The college has a huge library and good sports facilities with basketball, volleyball and tennis courts. We also have a swimming pool, and the computer labs are good with well-equipped computers. Classrooms are spacious, but the benches and cleanliness are a concern. The hostels are not that good.

reviews_list.review_title: An honest review of Sudha Rustagi College of Dental Sciences and Research.

review_content.Placements: Placements were offered in non-clinical work only. There were very few placements because hardly two companies visited this college. The average salary offered was Rs.16,000 per month to Rs.18,000 per month, with which your expenses will not be covered. Unless you have a strong network, you can't get a good placement outside the college. You have to start learning practical concepts in clinics, and these clinics hardly pay you.
review_content.Infrastructure: There was no Wi-Fi facility. A few classrooms were air-conditioned, but it did not work well. The mics in classrooms did not work well. There were common rooms where all students of UG and PG had their lunch. Cleanliness was not up to the mark. The library was a good place with good furniture but had outdated books. You will not get international books for reference on a topic. The books were very few in number. If you have a class, then you are not allowed to sit in the library. There was no air-conditioning. There was a digital library, and it was a room with six outdated computers. They did not work properly. There were power cuts during college hours, so you could not stay in the hostel in the summer. The canteen provided oily food without taste, and limited options were available. There were coolers, but we were not allowed to use them. The principal permitted us to play sports after requesting a lot.

individual_reviews.title: Such an amazing college with great infrastructure that makes highly efficient doctors.

content.Placements: There was 80% placement of our batch with a higher package of 10 LPA, and the lowest package being 5LPA. One of my batchmates also got a placement at the ESIC government hospital. The college organised drives for placement in a variety of companies that involved clinical as well as non-clinical roles.
content.Infrastructure: All the classrooms are well furnished and equipped with the latest projectors. The infrastructure is also amazing. The hostels are clean and have all the facilities like laundry, gym, and mess. Mess is very clean. The food in the mess tastes amazing and is hygienic.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sudha Rustagi Tour!

content.Placements: 100 students per year enroll in BDS, and 27 students per year in MS. The total fee for the BDS course is 15 lacs at our college. All the students get internships after all the exams in 4 years of the course, and they secure internships in their own OPD. There are various top roles in this course.
content.Infrastructure: Good-ventilated air-conditioned lecture halls are provided with smart boards. Labs are well-maintained, with proper space for the students. The library is spacious and equipped with all the necessary materials for the course. Medical facilities are good, as there is a hospital for the college just behind the building.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: An honest review of Sudha Rustagi College of Dental Sciences and Research.

content.Placements: Placements were offered in non-clinical work only. There were very few placements because hardly two companies visited this college. The average salary offered was Rs.16,000 per month to Rs.18,000 per month, with which your expenses will not be covered. Unless you have a strong network, you can't get a good placement outside the college. You have to start learning practical concepts in clinics, and these clinics hardly pay you.
content.Infrastructure: There was no Wi-Fi facility. A few classrooms were air-conditioned, but it did not work well. The mics in classrooms did not work well. There were common rooms where all students of UG and PG had their lunch. Cleanliness was not up to the mark. The library was a good place with good furniture but had outdated books. You will not get international books for reference on a topic. The books were very few in number. If you have a class, then you are not allowed to sit in the library. There was no air-conditioning. There was a digital library, and it was a room with six outdated computers. They did not work properly. There were power cuts during college hours, so you could not stay in the hostel in the summer. The canteen provided oily food without taste, and limited options were available. There were coolers, but we were not allowed to use them. The principal permitted us to play sports after requesting a lot.
